description: Look up one found person's email address. This spends Find affiliates credits: one of the brand's free reveals first, then 1 credit, charged only when an address is found (a lookup that finds nothing costs nothing, and a person already revealed is never charged again). Ask the person before each reveal, saying it uses a credit. Returns the address, whether it is verified (only a verified address can be sent to from LinkJolt), and the credits and free reveals left. If it answers no_credits, tell the person: credits are bought on the Find affiliates page. Requires Pro plan or higher.
name: reveal_prospect_email
title: Reveal a found person's email
